observations.title: Hitch a ridden horse
observations.player_action: Put a lead in the horse's special inventory slot and click a fence while mounted.
observations.outcome: The horse is leashed to the fence; the lead stays in its slot when detached.

observations.title: Cross water with a horse
observations.player_action: Use jump while riding a supported horse in water, or place a horse in a boat.
observations.outcome: Supported ridden horses can swim and horses can fit in boats.
conditions: The cannot_swim entity tag excludes some abstract horses by default.
